headline: Chainflip reported that 122.86 BTC was stolen in addition to an estimated $4.86 million from its Ethereum vault; no recovery was reported. Fluidkey confirmed about $1.6 million in unauthorized transfers, and Rackspace warned that an intruder could read secrets in some customers’ Kubernetes clusters.

incidents.what: Chainflip confirmed Bitcoin theft in addition to its Ethereum outflow and offered a recovery bounty, but has not reported funds returned.
Rackspace warned that an intruder logged in with leaked credentials and could access Kubernetes secrets in some customer clusters.
Fluidkey’s post-mortem confirms that flaws in an outdated logging tool exposed session data. Private spending keys remained on users’ devices.
incidents.scale: About $1.6M in unauthorized transfers from 52 accounts

incidents.what: Cyber reported unexpected minting on Solana and a matching outflow from its bridge on Ethereum; Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER transfers.
Norway’s digitalisation agency said a denial-of-service attack disrupted its national ID-porten sign-in service.
YMCA confirmed unauthorized access to its Youth For Causes portal but could not determine whether personal data was copied.
The Taiwanese company reported an intrusion into its information systems and said it had no material operational impact.
Airbyte restored Intercom after taking Cloud services offline for containment, but 15 other API connectors remained down.
Travelsoft began restoring the bookings platform in phases after shutting it down following unauthorized access.
The Icelandic provider’s managing director said seven websites were destroyed in the attack and that services would return in phases.
Osiris listed the campus after the school’s earlier confirmation that some data had been exposed; the listing did not establish the scope.
SafePay listed the financing company on its extortion site; the claim does not establish a breach or service interruption.
